design.help: The default design is built into the application. Custom files override it file by file (the same relative path wins): the invoice.typ template, fonts in fonts/, the logo logo.svg or logo.png, a stamp or signature signature.png. Upload them to the draft below, try it with a preview and activate it (an operator can also push them with `invoiceapp design push`). Already archived PDFs stay unchanged.
